wall_screen.file: 02_人体骨骼晶格肌肉方案/输出/integration_review/s1_series_elbow/nominal_spring_spool_mu_30_adjusted_flexor_wall.json

scope: Quasi-static energy minimum with fixed recorded tension and frictionless cable. Selected nodes slide only along the sampled load rays; endpoints and unprobed nodes stay fixed. Wall supports are independent unilateral radial springs at the selected discretization. Stiffness values are sensitivity inputs, not identified TPU properties. Segment-wise contact, deformation outside the support direction, pressure, strength and feedback into arm motion are not evaluated.
